hero.lead: I design, deploy and maintain IT environments that simply work. Focused on security, business continuity and a web experience polished end to end.

about.title: Infrastructure as the invisible base that lets everything run.
about.p1: I am Ángel Fernández, a **systems administrator and web developer**. To me, technology has to be **at the service of the business**. When infrastructure is well built, nobody talks about it. **It just works.**
about.p2: I come from the **hospitality sector**, where I have managed environments with network segmentation, virtualization and several servers running in parallel. Places where downtime is not an anecdote: **it is a serious problem**. That taught me to build everything I do on **documentation, standardization and business continuity**.
about.p3: Alongside that, I design and build **professional websites** for companies and freelancers who want an online presence that is **polished, fast and easy to maintain**. No bloated templates, no fine print.

services.title: Two disciplines, one standard.
services.lead: I work with companies and professionals that need a reliable technical base and a careful web presence. Both built to last and grow.
services.s1Lead: Stable, secure, documented IT environments so your team works without friction.
services.s2Lead: Custom professional websites. Fast, maintainable, built to represent you well.
services.s2b1: Design and development of professional pages
services.s2b2: Corporate sites, portfolios and landing pages
